newsitem.title: USA: Stone Container eliminates common dividend.
newsitem.headline: Stone Container eliminates common dividend.

text.p: Stone Container Corp said Monday its board of directors decided to eliminate the company's common stock dividend, in light of losses for the company for the last three quarters.

"Given the current industry conditions that have resulted in losses for the company during the last three quarters, the board felt it was appropriate to eliminate the cash dividend on our common stock, and use our internally generated funds to reduce indebtedness, at least until such time as price improvements become more widespread in the industry for our product lines," Roger Stone, chairman and chief executive of the pulp, paper and manufacturing company said in a statement.
The company had declared a dividend for the past six quarters.
Stone said it believed pricing would improve in the near term and contribute to the company's return to profitability.
"The company will consider a prompt resumption of cash dividends on our common stock as our profitability improves," Stone said.
Stone shares were down 3/8 at 14-1/4 Monday.
